title: Roland Filter Designs with the IR3109 / AS3109
summary: How Roland used its IR3109 four-pole OTA filter chip (now cloned as AS3109): the datasheet filter, then the Juno-6, SH-101, Jupiter-8 and Jupiter-6 versions, and the Boss PH-2 phaser.

sources.title: Roland filter designs with the IR3109 or AS3109
sources.author: Tom Wiltshire (Electric Druid)
